articles.title: Trump Media’s Q1 loss widens to $406 million on bitcoin, CRO markdowns
articles.snippet: The loss was primarily driven by $244 million in unrealized losses on cryptocurrency holdings and an additional $108.2 million investment loss.

articles.title: BlackRock deepens tokenization push with new onchain fund offerings
articles.snippet: The world's largest asset manager filed paperwork to expand its tokenized fund lineup as real-world assets grow 200% year over year.

articles.title: Three young DeFi apps return $100M in revenue to token holders in 30 days
articles.snippet: Hyperliquid, EdgeX and Pump.fun returned a combined $96 million to token holders in 30 days, as the crypto community shifts its focus from transaction volumes to real earnings.

articles.title: Trump Media posts $406M quarterly loss as crypto bets turn sour
articles.snippet: Trump Media’s $405.9 million net loss was driven mostly by unrealized losses on Bitcoin bought at last summer’s peak and Cronos tokens acquired through a Crypto.com deal.

articles.title: Tether's Medical AI Runs on Your Phone and Outperforms Models 16x Its Size
articles.snippet: QVAC MedPsy squeezes clinical AI onto a smartphone, beating Google's MedGemma-27B on real-world scenarios while using three times fewer compute resources.
